item.title: Bridges & Brunch with Strasburg Scooter Tours — Mon Aug 31 — Strasburg Scooter Tours
item.description:
Experience a relaxing morning ride through the back roads of Amish Country in Lancaster County, PA. Along the way to a 19th century covered bridge, enjoy the scenery of rolling hills, breathtaking views, and our Amish neighbors going about their daily routines. Itinerary Duration: 1.5-2 hours Some of our past tours have included:
A guided tour of one of Lancaster County’s most beautiful covered bridges An opportunity for a close up of daily life in Amish Country $10 dining voucher to one of two of Strasburg’s favorites brunch spots, Casey Jones’ Restaurant and Speckled Hen*
And each trip is unique, so you never know what we might have in store for you! *Unfortunately, we regret to inform you that some of the food offerings on the tour may not be considered ‘Kosher.’ We apologize for any inconvenience.
Source: Discover Lancaster

item.title: Bastidas Soccer Academy Training Camp — Mon Aug 31, 9:00 AM — Manheim Central Middle School
item.description:
Established in 1999, the Bastidas Soccer Academy emphasizes the importance of basic skill and ball mastery. We are passionate about teaching you to have fun and develop a winning attitude. All boys and girls from any school or district, entering grades 3-8, are invited to attend this premier camp to kick off the fall season. Registration is $200 per player (or $190 each for a sibling group) and will include:
Camp T-shirt USSF Licensed Coaches (including “A” License coach Trajano Bastidas) and USYS ODP Coaches Camp features– league play, king of the hill, soccer dance, small sided games, stations Main focuses– first touch, passing, receiving, finishing, having fun!
Players should arrive at least 10 minutes early each day with proper attire, sneakers, cleats, shin guards, plenty of water, and a snack for the mid-point break. Questions? item.title: IMPROMPTU: LV Off The Beaten Goatpath 23R — Tue Sep 1, 9:00 AM
item.description:
Lancaster Bicycle Club (LBC) Meetup RIDE LEADER: Jan Zerfoss, average pace \~13 mph. Cue and Ride with GPS link: [Off the Beaten Goatpath](https://routes.lancasterbikeclub.net/cue/lv-off-the-beaten-goatpath-23r/) **Be Safe, Have Fun, and Ride Together**
This is a casual ride and the ride leader will ride at the advertised pace. Some riders may ride faster than the leader so we'll likely break into one or more smaller groups with stops to regroup periodically. Please stay with other riders in your pace group so everyone has someone to ride with and nobody is riding solo. Usually no designated sweep but nobody will get dropped.
Helmets are mandatory. No earbuds. Please bring water and a basic repair kit (spare tube, tire levers, pump/CO2 inflator).

item.title: Knock for Nancy Mannion--Lancaster Township and Lancaster City — Tue Sep 1, 2:00 PM — 1028 Woods Ave
item.description:
Join us as we knock on doors and talk to neighbors to elect Dr. Nancy Mannion RN to the US House of Representatives! Nancy is seeking to represent all of us in the 11th district--Lancaster County and Southern York County. We will also share information about the Governor and Lt. Governor with voters. Whether you are an experienced field operative or new to door-to-door canvassing, we need you! We'll provide training and troubleshooting, and pair you up with a more experienced buddy if you wish.
